title: DHC-6 Twin Otter 短場起降飛機
subcategoryTitle: 民航機與世界航空案例
subcategoryTitleEn: Civil aircraft and world aviation cases
summary: 以Twin Otter短場多用途情境學習高升力、載荷、螺槳與水陸選配的模型邊界；不給起降距離、操作速度或場地許可。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use Twin Otter short-field utility context to study high-lift, loads, propellers and optional amphibious-model limits without takeoff distance, operating speed or site approval. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 高升力與速度尺度：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: High lift and speed scale: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 高升力與速度尺度 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of High lift and speed scale and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以升力平衡重量可求給定CLmax的速度尺度；這只是失速敏感度模型，不能取代飛機手冊與包線。
steps.instructionEn: Balancing lift and weight gives a speed scale for a specified CLmax; it is a stall-sensitivity model, not an aircraft manual or envelope.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非DHC-6 Twin Otter 短場起降飛機實際性能或製程：W=12000 N，ρ=1.2 kg/m³，S=16 m²，CLmax=1.5。式 V*=√[2W/(ρSCLmax)]，基準結果 28.8675135 m/s。適用條件：準穩態教學平衡且CLmax已知；不作起降速度或操作指示。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for DHC-6 Twin Otter STOL aircraft: W=12000 N, rho=1.2 kg/m³, S=16 m² and CLmax=1.5. Formula V*=√[2W/(ρSCLmax)] gives 28.8675135 m/s. Conditions: Quasi-steady teaching balance with known CLmax; not a takeoff/landing speed instruction.
steps.failure: 將迎角超過峰值後的CL視為繼續增加，會低估所需速度尺度。
steps.failureEn: Assuming CL keeps rising beyond its peak underestimates the speed scale.
steps.check: 用同一重量與密度比較襟翼模型，標記CLmax來自哪條量測曲線。
steps.checkEn: Compare flap models at equal weight and density and identify the measured curve supplying CLmax.

knowledge.title: 高升力與速度尺度
knowledge.text: 以升力平衡重量可求給定CLmax的速度尺度；這只是失速敏感度模型，不能取代飛機手冊與包線。
knowledge.textEn: Balancing lift and weight gives a speed scale for a specified CLmax; it is a stall-sensitivity model, not an aircraft manual or envelope.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再僅把W改成14400 N；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 28.8675135 改為 31.6227766 m/s。在算式區重算並記下對「高升力與速度尺度」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only W to 14400 N, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 28.8675135 to 31.6227766 m/s. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for High lift and speed scale, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

steps.title: 機翼升力與構型：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Wing lift and configuration: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 機翼升力與構型 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Wing lift and configuration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 升力由動壓、參考翼面積與升力係數相乘；係數含翼型、迎角、雷諾數及壓縮性條件。
steps.instructionEn: Lift multiplies dynamic pressure, reference wing area and lift coefficient; the coefficient depends on section, incidence, Reynolds number and compressibility.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非DHC-6 Twin Otter 短場起降飛機實際性能或製程：ρ=1.2 kg/m³，V=30 m/s，S=2 m²，CL=0.6。式 L=ρV²SCL/2，基準結果 648 N。適用條件：低速固定CL模型，未描述失速或三維分離。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for DHC-6 Twin Otter STOL aircraft: rho=1.2 kg/m³, V=30 m/s, S=2 m² and CL=0.6. Formula L=ρV²SCL/2 gives 648 N. Conditions: Low-speed fixed-CL model, excluding stall and three-dimensional separation.
steps.failure: 使用濕面積取代參考翼面積會使係數不可比；分離後不能保持線性CL。
steps.failureEn: Using wetted area instead of reference wing area breaks coefficient comparisons; CL cannot remain linear after separation.
steps.check: 扣除支架皮重，以同一面積正規化力天平讀值，分別記錄迎角上掃與下掃。
steps.checkEn: Subtract support tare, normalize balance forces with one area definition, and record increasing and decreasing incidence separately.
